Design-accepted residual risk (Deferred Items, restated): there is no cross-invocation requeue cap — a failure that persists a transient-class code but never heals re-requeues at every compact, spending one provider attempt cycle each time; receipt visibility is the v1 mitigation.

If an owner requeue fails mid-walk, sweep returns the error and that invocation's receipt is lost; committed requeues are durable and surface as in-flight on the next sweep — partial-failure receipt accounting was not specified.
AC-3.7's CLI execution leg is the story's explicit Scope-out to Story 5's process suite; the shared receipt-schema validator landed here for that leg to assert against.
Untested edge (schema-valid, outside the plan's TC set): sweep on a thread with no derived forms returns an empty-owners receipt.
